description: Inventaire des places de stationnement pour personnes à mobilité réduite is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agence d’Urbanisme de la Région Grenobloise. Inventory of parking spaces for people with reduced mobility, carried out in 2021 by the Urban Planning Agency on order from Grenoble-Alpes Métropole, based on OSM data and then common feedback and field collection by the Urban Planning Agency, to check whether the spaces are really accessible to people with reduced mobility, especially those in ... Coverage: Agence d’Urbanisme de la Région Grenobloise. The portal shows the English title as "Inventory of parking spaces for people with reduced mobility" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Agence d’Urbanisme de la Région Grenobloise. Its keywords include stationnement, mobilite, pmr, fauteuil-roulant-ou-mobilite-reduite, handicap, mobilite-reduite. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2025-05-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
